prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent vehicle sprite for the GoTogether carpool website, preview artwork.
Primary request: Create ONE complete 尊界 V800 / MAEXTRO V800 luxury MPV, faithfully based on reference image 1, isolated on a truly transparent background.
Input images: Image 1 (v800-gold-black.jpg) is the exact vehicle identity, body design, proportions and paint reference. Image 2 (su7.webp) is ONLY the website presentation reference for slightly elevated front-three-quarter angle, soft realistic 3D product rendering, isolated silhouette and subtle contact shadow; do NOT borrow the SU7 car body or color.
Subject: The tall long-wheelbase V800 MPV in warm champagne gold upper body/roof and glossy black lower body. Keep its long straight roof and rectangular side windows, prominent tall faceted vertical hexagonal front emblem, thin horizontal upper headlights with upright stacked point-light clusters at their outside ends, large mostly closed flat disc-style polished alloy wheels, sliding side doors, roof sensor, chrome trim. Preserve the broad flat MPV face. This is V800, not the S800 sedan.
Composition/framing: Whole single vehicle, stationary, front-left three-quarter view with the front pointing toward the lower left of the image. Camera modestly elevated to see the hood and a little roof like the SU7 reference, but retain real tall MPV proportions. Centered with generous clear margins around all extremities. Both visible wheels and all mirrors fully inside frame. Horizontal composition; the vehicle occupies about 85% of width.
Style/medium: Detailed polished realistic product render, natural believable body geometry, softly simplified only enough to read at website thumbnail size. Bright neutral diffuse studio lighting with clean highlights so the black panels and front face remain legible.
Scene/backdrop: Genuine alpha transparency, no scenery, no studio floor, no colored rectangle, no horizon. Only a very light compact semitransparent contact shadow beneath the tires/body.
Constraints: No humans, no extra cars, no parking outlines, no pedestal, no ground tile, no labels or captions, no watermark. Remove source scenery and sunset reflections. Do not crop the vehicle. Avoid deeply black crushed shadows. Keep the recognisable V800 exterior identity; no fantasy redesign.

references.role: website presentation and rendering style reference
